display_name: LoRa W24 整段 DURA 新增噪声监督对照（Full）
description: Matched 8192-point native two-update DURA with common source IQ and perturbation draws. Compare original-wave recovery against additive-only removal before the original W24 front end.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Original 7615e8e4 archived training release for fitting; archived W24 inference release for prediction.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: TX-blind source U IQ and paired generic perturbations only until freeze. Source V and, if qualified, Full-only target; no Residual execution.

checkpoint.initialization: Same random seed 2026112991, 111698 parameters per arm, no imported checkpoint or optimizer.

sources.role: Archived code and frozen external comparator only
Previously frozen source comparator only in independent evaluation. No fitting or freezing access.
Unchanged original-loss 24,000-step U-Net for frozen evaluation comparison only, no fitting access

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered source U and physical IDs for scratch fitting. All comparison checkpoints and frozen E104 opened only for post-freeze comparison.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No checkpoint used in fit. Historical DURA, U-Net and W24 checkpoint rows are independent frozen source comparisons.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze step 24000. Candidate .5 readout must strictly beat all matched and fixed controls on six-scene count, match the best on low urban, and match direct clean before Full target.

execution.gpu_policy: Prefer 0, 3; use 5 or 6 subject to 12 GiB and incumbent limits; one fit per card.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on a systemic technical/protocol failure, incompatible source or frozen comparator, collision, or prediction/scoring failure. Preserve all artifacts. Source scores gate only target eligibility via preregistered paired rules.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --native-additive after the three formal Full shards freeze.

rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 24000 scratch updates, batch 16, AdamW; held steps 2000, 6000, 12000, 18000 and final 24000.

rows.method: Remove additive noise while preserving noiseless generic action

notes: Same raw source packets and RNG streams for initialization, sampling, short echoes/phase drift and additive noise. Both arms read only TX-blind U_s through freeze.
Only waveform reference differs: original recorded IQ versus post-action IQ before addition. Both cross-reference native NMSEs are logged as detached metrics.
